choose.when: SELECT owner_id FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_lead WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lead_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('CONVERTED', 'CLOSED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_opportunity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'OPEN' AND stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_quote WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quote_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('ACCEPTED', 'EXPIRED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_receivable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receivable_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status <> 'RECEIVED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_renewal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND renewal_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST', 'CLOSED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT owner_id FROM crm_service_ticket WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') FOR UPDATE
